packages.name: kaivideo
packages.title: KaiVideo
packages.author: Mizuiro
packages.description: Video player for Switch 2: your films and series from the SD card, a network folder (Windows, NAS, WebDAV) or your Jellyfin, Emby or Plex server, with hardware decoding (H.264, VP9, AV1), HEVC on the CPU, 4K, downloads to watch offline, Live TV, your own IPTV list and Stremio addons, skip intro, subtitles in your choice of fonts, and 9 languages.
